acceptance: A mechanical-slice pass needs every required check to pass AND at least one executed required endpoint with a positive and a rejected negative case. Zero checks, all-optional checks, a missing, stale, blocked or not_run required check never earn it. A pass licenses the mechanical slice for the declared point only.

bio_bridge.required_readout: a calibrated EI of the candidate's rays in the stated tissue and stage, with unit and bounds; EI is an assumed range here

context.cell_state: not applicable to the mechanical slice
context.construct_context: none: the sequence reference is unresolved
context.species: not established: a design candidate, not an organism
context.tissue: fin ray modelled as a constant-EI cantilever (assumed)

candidate.scope: the mechanical slice of an assembly of pinned files; not a genome, not a construct and not a flyable or viable animal

next_measurement.assumptions: priors, noise and costs are declared, not calibrated; selection is by expected target-variance reduction per assumed cost

not_claimed: a working or validated fin, ray, genome or organism
that EI of any real fin ray is known (assumed range only)
any biological success probability (none is computed)
that the observed-allometry update validates fin mechanics or sequence-function (it is separate observed-data evidence, and it worsened held-out error)

required_checks.what: end-loaded FEM tip deflection and slope equal P L^3/(3EI) and P L^2/(2EI) at the declared point
a law mutant, a unit mutant, a context mix-up and a domain exit are each refused for their intended reason
V1-saved-deflection-section@1 on the saved FEM section
V2-saved-tip-and-slope@1 on the saved FEM summary
the pinned fin_mechanics receipt and the pinned analytic controls hold

sequence_reference.why: GRCz11 coordinates for the tested element are unresolved in the ledger

slice.EI_crit_note: the receipt's critical EI is for its UNIFORM pressure load; the end-loaded slice needs its own, derived here from P L^3/(3EI) and P L^2/(2EI) with the declared limits
slice.name: end-loaded cantilever (tip point load)
slice.not_this_law: uniformly loaded beam: delta = q L^4 / (8 EI)
